title: Death March
description:
Deal 8 damage.
Deals 4 additional damage for each card drawn during your turn.
upgraded_description:
Deal 9 damage.
Deals 6 additional damage for each card drawn during your turn.
notes: Damage scales with cards drawn during your turn (excluding hand draw phase). The base damage applies regardless of cards drawn; the bonus damage is multiplied by the number of cards drawn this turn.
